title: Local Storage and State Persistence — Project

pool_config.pool_brief: Build a persistent web application that saves and loads data using browser storage. Your solution must use: localStorage.setItem and getItem, JSON.stringify when saving arrays/objects, JSON.parse when loading, rendering stored data to the DOM on page load, adding and deleting items that persist across refresh, and a clear/reset function. All variables must use const or let.

projects.title: PiggyVest Savings Goal Tracker
projects.scenario: Build a persistent savings goal tracker for PiggyVest. Users can add goals, mark them as achieved, delete them, and see their data survive page refreshes. Track total savings and visit count.
requirements: On page load, read goals from localStorage (key: 'piggy_goals'), parse the JSON, and render them to the DOM; if no data exists, start with an empty array
Add a form that on submit creates a new goal object {id, name, target, achieved: false}, pushes it to the array, saves with localStorage.setItem + JSON.stringify, and re-renders
Add a 'Mark Achieved' button on each goal that updates the achieved property, saves to localStorage, and re-renders with a visual change (class toggle)
Add a delete button on each goal that removes it from the array, saves to localStorage, and re-renders
Add a 'Clear All Goals' button that calls localStorage.removeItem for the goals key and clears the DOM
Use sessionStorage to track the number of times the page has been loaded in this tab (session page views); display it on the page
Display a total goal count and achieved count that updates in real time as goals are added/removed/achieved

projects.title: GTBank Budget Planner
projects.scenario: Build a persistent monthly budget planner for a GTBank user. Users can add expenses, categorize them, delete entries, and track spending that persists across page refreshes.
requirements: On page load, read expenses from localStorage (key: 'gtb_expenses'), parse JSON, and render them to the DOM; if no data, start with an empty array
Add a form that creates an expense object {id, description, amount, category, date}, saves with JSON.stringify to localStorage, and re-renders
Add category filter buttons that show/hide expenses by category without modifying stored data
Add a delete button on each expense that removes it from the array, saves, and re-renders
Add a 'Reset Budget' button that calls localStorage.removeItem and clears the DOM
Use sessionStorage to track the current session's total spending (resets on new tab); display it
Display running total of all expenses and count, updating in real time

projects.title: FairMoney Loan Request Tracker
projects.scenario: Build a persistent loan request tracker for FairMoney. Users can submit loan requests, track their status, delete entries, and see data persist across refreshes.
requirements: On page load, read loan requests from localStorage (key: 'fair_loans'), parse JSON, render to DOM; start with empty array if no data
Add a form that creates a loan object {id, purpose, amount, status: 'pending', date}, saves to localStorage with JSON.stringify, and re-renders
Add an 'Approve' button on each pending loan that changes status to 'approved', saves, and re-renders with visual change
Add a delete button that removes the loan from the array, saves, and re-renders
Add a 'Clear History' button that removes the localStorage key and clears the DOM
Use sessionStorage to store and display the username entered in a separate input (persists within the tab only)
Display counts of pending, approved, and total loans that update in real time

projects.title: Chipper Cash Contact Manager
projects.scenario: Build a persistent contact manager for Chipper Cash transfers. Users can add contacts with country info, favourite them, delete them, and data persists across refreshes.
requirements: On page load, read contacts from localStorage (key: 'chipper_contacts'), parse JSON, render to DOM; start with empty array if no data
Add a form that creates a contact object {id, name, phone, country, favourite: false}, saves to localStorage, and re-renders
Add a 'Star' button that toggles favourite status, saves, and re-renders with visual highlight
Add a delete button that removes the contact, saves, and re-renders
Add a 'Clear Contacts' button that removes the localStorage key and clears the DOM
Use sessionStorage to track a 'last searched' value: when the user types in the search box, save the search term to sessionStorage; restore it on page load within the same tab
Display total contacts and favourite count that update in real time

projects.title: Konga Wishlist with Persistence
projects.scenario: Build a persistent product wishlist for Konga. Users can add products, mark them as purchased, delete them, and their wishlist survives page refreshes.
requirements: On page load, read wishlist from localStorage (key: 'konga_wishlist'), parse JSON, render to DOM; start with empty array if no data
Add a form that creates a product object {id, name, price, purchased: false}, saves to localStorage, and re-renders
Add a 'Purchased' button that toggles the purchased property, saves, and re-renders with strikethrough styling
Add a delete button that removes the product, saves, and re-renders
Add a 'Clear Wishlist' button that calls localStorage.removeItem and clears the DOM
Use sessionStorage to track session visit count (increments each page load in same tab); display it
Display total items, purchased count, and total wishlist value that update in real time

descriptors.full: setItem, getItem, and removeItem all used correctly; data persists across page refresh; clear/reset removes stored data
descriptors.partial: setItem and getItem used but removeItem missing, or data doesn't actually persist on refresh
descriptors.none: No localStorage usage or entirely broken

descriptors.full: JSON.stringify used when saving arrays/objects; JSON.parse used when loading; handles the null case (first visit); no JSON errors
descriptors.partial: stringify/parse used but null case not handled (crashes on first visit)
descriptors.none: Attempting to store objects without stringify, or parse missing

descriptors.full: Stored data rendered to DOM on page load; every mutation (add, delete, update) saves AND re-renders; UI stays in sync with storage; sessionStorage used for at least one feature
descriptors.partial: Data renders on load but updates don't save, or sessionStorage not used
descriptors.none: No DOM rendering from stored data

descriptors.full: const/let used; render function separated and reusable; save function separated; IDs generated for items; counters accurate
descriptors.partial: Minor issues — render and save logic mixed together, or counters inaccurate
descriptors.none: var used, no separation of concerns, or app crashes
